16:     McpConnectorSettings,
17: )

21: class MCPClientConnector:
22:     """Ingests a catalog, resources and selected tool outputs from an MCP server."""
23: 
24:     kind = "mcp"
25: 
26:     def __init__(
27:         self,
28:         config: ConnectorConfig,
29:         sink: IngestSink,
30:         client_factory: Callable[[], Client] | None = None,
31:     ) -> None:
32:         self.name = config.name
33:         self.settings: McpConnectorSettings = config.mcp_settings()
34:         self._sink = sink
35:         if client_factory is None:
36:             self._client_factory: Callable[[], Client] = lambda: Client(self.settings.url)
37:         else:
38:             self._client_factory = client_factory
39: 
40:     async def health(self) -> HealthStatus:
41:         try:
42:             async with self._client_factory() as client:
43:                 tools = await client.list_tools()
44:         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - health must never raise
45:             return HealthStatus(ok=False, detail=str(exc))
46:         count = len(tools) if tools is not None else 0
47:         return HealthStatus(ok=True, detail=f"{count} tool(s) available")
48: 
49:     async def ingest(self) -> IngestBatch:
50:         batch = IngestBatch(connector_name=self.name)
51:         async with self._client_factory() as client:
52:             tools = await client.list_tools()
53:             resources = await client.list_resources()
54: 
55:             tool_names = [tool.name for tool in tools] if tools else []
56:             resource_list = list(resources) if resources else []
57:             resource_names = [res.name for res in resource_list]
58: 
59:             batch.records.append(
60:                 IngestRecord(
61:                     id=f"{self.name}:catalog",
62:                     source_name=self.name,
63:                     source_kind=self.kind,
64:                     item_type="catalog",
65:                     name="catalog",
66:                     content=json.dumps({"tools": tool_names, "resources": resource_names}),
67:                     raw={
68:                         "tools": tool_names,
69:                         "resources": [
70:                             {"name": res.name, "uri": str(getattr(res, "uri", ""))}
71:                             for res in resource_list
72:                         ],
73:                     },
74:                 )
75:             )
76: 
77:             for res in resource_list:
78:                 uri = str(getattr(res, "uri", ""))
79:                 try:
80:                     blocks = await client.read_resource(uri)
81:                     for block in blocks or []:
82:                         text = getattr(block, "text", None)
83:                         batch.records.append(
84:                             IngestRecord(
85:                                 id=f"{self.name}:resource:{res.name}",
86:                                 source_name=self.name,
87:                                 source_kind=self.kind,
88:                                 item_type="resource",
89:                                 name=res.name,
90:                                 content=text if text is not None else str(block),
91:                                 raw={"uri": uri},
92:                             )
93:                         )
94:                 except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - collect, never abort
95:                     batch.errors.append(f"resource {res.name}: {exc}")
96: 
97:             for tool_name in self.settings.tools:
98:                 try:
99:                     result = await client.call_tool(tool_name, {})
100:                     batch.records.append(
101:                         IngestRecord(
102:                             id=f"{self.name}:tool:{tool_name}",
103:                             source_name=self.name,
104:                             source_kind=self.kind,
105:                             item_type="tool_result",
106:                             name=tool_name,
107:                             content=_tool_result_text(result),
108:                             raw={},
109:                         )
110:                     )
111:                 except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - collect, never abort
112:                     batch.errors.append(f"tool {tool_name}: {exc}")
113: 
114:         self._sink.append(batch)
115:         return batch
116:

118: def _tool_result_text(result: Any) -> str:
119:     blocks = getattr(result, "content", None)
120:     if blocks:
121:         parts: list[str] = []
122:         for block in blocks:
123:             text = getattr(block, "text", None)
124:             if text is not None:
125:                 parts.append(text)
126:             else:
127:                 data = getattr(block, "data", None)
128:                 parts.append(str(data) if data is not None else str(block))
